items.title: Clem Raymond Interview, 1958-08-25
items.q: Johnson. He was at Dunbar's Tennessee Tanks, too.

ctx.x: No, out of school, yes. I worked for the United Fruit Company boat. Oh, yeah. Yeah. And that's how I got to New York. So, I got with those Johnson boys, as I said. Let's see, one was a guitar player and the other was a bass player. Did you know them? The Johnsons?

Well, there's so many Johnsons. Is that Bill Johnson, you think? No, no, no, no. Wasn't that bunch? No, Bill Johnson from Monk. From out here. The bass player, yeah. He was out here already. That's why I remember him.
Johnson. He was at Dunbar's Tennessee Tanks, too. Well, yeah, that's when I got out here, but I didn't go back, see?
